description: Billqo stores each user's financial records in that user's Google Sheet. Firestore is server-only infrastructure metadata and never the financial source of truth.

googleConnections.title: Google Sheets connection
googleConnections.description: Server-managed encrypted OAuth refresh-token metadata and the user's selected spreadsheet reference.

oauthStates.title: Temporary OAuth state
oauthStates.description: Short-lived PKCE state used once to complete a Google Sheets authorization.

financialOperations.title: Idempotency records
financialOperations.description: Short-lived server records that prevent duplicated Sheet mutations after a retry.

rateLimitBuckets.title: Rate-limit counters
rateLimitBuckets.description: Short-lived server counters keyed only by hashed subjects so all server instances enforce the same API quota.
